title: Parabolic Reflector Dish
description: Tilt rolling rocks on a grid and find the load after a billion spin cycles.
writeup:
## Approach

Parse the grid of round rocks (`O`), fixed rocks (`#`), and empty space (`.`). Tilting north moves each `O` up until it hits another rock or the edge.

## Part 1

Tilt north once. Compute the total load as the sum of `(rows - row_index)` for each round rock.

## Part 2

A spin cycle tilts north, west, south, east in sequence. Rotating the grid 90° clockwise after each tilt-north makes all four directions use the same tilt logic. Run spin cycles until the grid state repeats (cycle detection via a dictionary). Then compute `(1,000,000,000 - current_step) % cycle_length` to skip ahead and find the final load.
